cliques.name: Jocks
cliques.description: You must be an athlete with little interest in intellectual culture to join this clique.

cliques.name: Nerds
cliques.description: You must be seen as overly intellectual or introverted to join this clique.

cliques.name: Hipsters
cliques.description: You must flaunt varied non-mainstream sensibilities to join this clique.

cliques.name: Popular Kids
cliques.description: You must be among the most popular kids in school to join this clique.

cliques.name: Social Floaters
cliques.description: You must demonstrate an uncanny ability to slip in with different groups to join this clique.

cliques.name: Talented Kids
cliques.description: You must be multi-talented to join this special clique.

cliques.name: Drama Kids
cliques.description: You must be obsessed with Broadway musicals and aspire to do theatre to join this clique.

cliques.name: Brainy Kids
cliques.description: You must have high smarts and grades to join this special clique.

cliques.name: Artsy Kids
cliques.description: You must be artistically inclined to join this creative clique.

cliques.name: Normals
cliques.description: You must be devoid of abnormalities to join this extremely average clique.

cliques.name: Band Geeks
cliques.description: You must enjoy blowing on or fingering instruments to join this clique.

cliques.name: Mean Girls
cliques.description: You must engage in gossip and crave popularity to join this elite clique.

cliques.name: Weebs
cliques.description: You must be obsessed with Japanese culture to join this strange clique.

cliques.name: Gamers
cliques.description: You must be obsessed with gaming and gamer culture to join this clique.

cliques.name: Skaters
cliques.description: You must dedicate your life to skating to join this rebellious clique.

cliques.name: Troublemakers
cliques.description: You must frequently get up to trouble in school to join this dubious clique.

cliques.name: Goths
cliques.description: You must enjoy dark attire and makeup to join this post-punk clique.

cliques.name: Loners
cliques.description: You must be disliked and unhappy to join this very lonely clique.
